meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把视频里的配乐与旁白混合好,做淡入淡出、音量自动压低与音效处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频里的背景音乐盖住了人声,想快速把两条音轨混好。
copy.tagline_en: Mix music and voiceover in your video with fades, ducking, and track effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if background music drowns out the voiceover and you need them balanced.

howto.what: 给已放进 HyperFrames 合成里的音频做混音处理:淡入淡出、交叉淡化、音量自动化、人声 carve、ducking 和效果链(如 EQ、压缩、混响等),预览与渲染共用同一实现。
howto.when: 当音频已放进 HyperFrames 合成、需要混音时触发:淡入淡出、ducking、人声 carve 等。找音频素材用 /media-use,剪辑时点用 /hyperframes-core。

say.text: 把这段音乐底下的人声做 carve,别让音乐整个变小声
say.note: 对音乐轨写 data-fx-carve,只削人声占的频段

say.text: 给旁白轨加 80 Hz 高通去掉隆隆声,再挂一个 limiter 当上限
say.note: 在元素上写 data-fx-chain,按信号顺序排列

say.text: 把三条旁白 clip 归成一个组,再用音乐轨去 carve 这个组

howto.what_en: Mixes audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition: fade-in/out, crossfades, volume and effect automation, ducking, voiceover carve, and per-track effect chains (EQ, compressor, reverb). Preview and render share one implementation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when audio is already placed in a HyperFrames composition and needs mixing, such as fades, ducking or voiceover carve. Sourcing audio is /media-use; clip timing is /hyperframes-core.

say_en.text: Carve the music bed under the voiceover instead of ducking the whole bed
say_en.note: Writes data-fx-carve on the music track

say_en.text: Add an 80 Hz highpass and a limiter to the narration track
say_en.note: Writes a data-fx-chain in signal order

say_en.text: Group the three narration clips and carve the music against the group
say_en.note: Uses data-audio-group so new clips are covered
